A '''[[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] guard''' protected the entrance to [[Alexi Garyn]]'s fortress on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]<ref name="Darth Maul" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> He was killed by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who was planning to assassinate the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]] in the fortress.<ref name="Darth Maul" />
